title: AUTH-047 controlled visibility acquisition

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A expires at controlled time T+900 seconds; no refresh credential exists
4. And the page is hidden after its T+60-second hide acquisition failed transiently
5. And request counts restart after that failure
6. When the controlled browser clock reaches T+120 seconds
7. And the browser changes this page from hidden to visible
8. And the controlled browser clock reaches T+875 seconds
9. Then the browser records exactly 1 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
10. And the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 11. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is absent

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled API responses, clock, visibility and suspension adapters. Unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle, real identity or service policy acceptance.
